title: Kozmos 3
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: Mete’s hardened exterior finally begins to crack as his traumatic childhood and fractured family dynamics come to light. At the same time, the KAOS app, once only a whisper, evolves into a concrete and escalating threat, pushing Neva College toward a breaking point. Meanwhile, Melina continues to unravel the secret surrounding the app, hoping to draw closer to Arın and the dangerous world he inhabits.
